name: Deathfire Touch
description:
Damaging a champion with an ability burns them for 3 - 12 based on level (+7.0% AP) (+2.5% bonus AD) magic damage per second. After burning for 3 seconds, the damage of the burn increases by 75% while they remain on fire.
Duration:
Single Target: 4s
Area of Effect: 2s
Damage over Time: 1s
